  • How It Works: Surgeons sequence the DNA and RNA of a patient's removed tumor within 72 hours to manufacture a customized vaccine targeting up to 20 patient-specific cancer mutations, training T-cells to destroy microscopic residual cancer cells.

Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma has historically carried a 5-year survival rate under 13% due to high rates of microscopic recurrence even after successful surgical resection.
